expect_red: the pane's open state round-trips through storage and reads closed when storage is absent, empty or throws

mutations.contract: Closing the pane is remembered as firmly as opening it.
mutations.note: A writer that only ever stores `open` reopens a pane the reader closed on every reload.

mutations.contract: A browser whose storage throws reads as closed rather than taking the page down.
mutations.note: file:// configurations throw on storage access; the read is reached at boot, before anything else could catch it.
